Test in which plane quadrant a point resides

**Panel:** Comma → Point · **Nickname:** `Quadrant`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Points | `Pt` | Point | List |  | Points for quadrant relation test |
| Plane | `Pl` | Plane | Item | `Plane.WorldXY` | Reference plane |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Relationship | `R` | Integer | List | Relationship (1 = quadrant I, 2 = quadrant II, 3 = quadrant III, 4 = quadrant IV) |
| Quadrant I | `I` | Integer | List | Indices in +X,+Y) |
| Quadrant II | `II` | Integer | List | Indices in -X,+Y) |
| Quadrant III | `III` | Integer | List | Indices in -X,-Y) |
| Quadrant IV | `IV` | Integer | List | Indices in +X,-Y) |
